versions.changelog: Align the self-contained Bellwire Skill and CLI with ClawHub's MIT-0 Skill license.
Declare Apache-2.0 in Skill metadata so registry licensing matches the bundled license.
Self-contained Private-first assets, non-printing Token storage, shared protocol validation, and stricter Direct conformance.
Initial public release: bind agents, manage live Surfaces, send typed Events, and diagnose delivery health.
